disposition: Additive P1.13 only. Frozen P0 and P1.1…P1.12 files stay byte-identical. P1_BINDING_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and P1_MCP_CONFIG_INVALID are reused.

codes.reference_rule: P1.13 CF-2…CF-4: invalid gateway control-flow declaration
P1.13 CF-5: gateway type outside exclusive and parallel
P1.13 TB-1…TB-2: statement names a flow or target outside the declaration
P1.13 TB-1: routing token has no at_gateway position
